title: Transport of a chosen pair square through a chart diagram
statement: Let V and Vprime be open covers of schemes Y and Yprime [def-pc-scheme], alpha an index map, r:Yprime->Y, and rho_d:Vprime_d->V_alpha(d) commuting with the cover projections. Let p:Z->Y and pprime:Z->Yprime satisfy pprime followed by r=p. Let A and Aprime be chart modules, M a module on Z, c_d:rho_d^*A_alpha(d) ~= Aprime_d, and delta_d maps of the pprime limit charts to the p limit charts commuting both with their maps to Z and with their stage-chart projections. Suppose epsilon compares p-pullbacks of A with restrictions of M, and epsilonprime equals its displayed transport through c, delta and the pullback composition comparisons [def-pc-overlap-pair-canonical-comparisons]. For any fixed pair a,b and any chosen pair map phi satisfying the earlier overlapPairSquare [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions], the explicit later pair map is pullback.fst^*(c_a.inv), followed by overlapPairBaseChangeHom(phi), followed by pullback.snd^*(c_b.hom). This map satisfies the later overlapPairSquare with epsilonprime. No original cover of X, direct-chart comparison e, finite presentation, coherence at the stage, or nonemptiness assumption is required.

proof.text: Construct the stage overlap map K, the limit overlap map L, and the old and new limit-to-stage overlap maps H and Hprime by pullback.lift. Record their projection equations. By hdeltaf, L preserves the map to Z; by hdeltav the two projections of Hprime followed by K and L followed by H agree, so pullback.hom_ext identifies these composites.

proof.text: Expand the transition of the restriction datum to its two mapComp-prime factors. Precompose and postcompose a universal pair square with invertible composition comparisons: cancellation gives an equivalent flattened equality between pullHom of epsilon_a and pullHom(phi) followed by pullHom of epsilon_b. Apply pullHom to the old flattened equality along L; pullHom_comp and pullHom_pullHom yield its restriction to the new overlap.

proof.text: Use the mapComp-prime pentagon at the two endpoints to prove that pulling a comparison-conjugated morphism commutes with flattening. Its one-sided version and pullHom_map compute the transported component homs from hepsilon. Its two-sided version computes the transported pair map, and pullHom_pullHom together with Hprime K = L H identifies its middle factor. Both computations use the same endpoint isomorphisms beta_a and beta_b. Substitute the computations in the new flattened square, cancel beta_b.inv followed by beta_b.hom, and use the restricted old equality. Finally specialize the proved categorical calculation to modulesPseudofunctor, translating its mapComp-prime factors to pullbackCompOfEq with the proved comparison identities.

lean.statement:
theorem overlap_pair_square_chart_transport
    {Y Y' Z : Scheme.{u}} (V : Y.OpenCover.{u}) (V' : Y'.OpenCover.{u})
    (α : V'.I₀ → V.I₀) (r : Y' ⟶ Y) (ρ : ∀ d, V'.X d ⟶ V.X (α d))
    (hr : ∀ d, ρ d ≫ V.f (α d) = V'.f d ≫ r)
    (p : Z ⟶ Y) (p' : Z ⟶ Y')
    (A : (d : V.I₀) → (V.X d).Modules)
    (A' : (d : V'.I₀) → (V'.X d).Modules) (M : Z.Modules)
    (c : ∀ d, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (ρ d)).obj (A (α d)) ≅ A' d)
    (δ : ∀ d, (V'.pullback₁ p').X d ⟶ (V.pullback₁ p).X (α d))
    (hδf : ∀ d, δ d ≫ (V.pullback₁ p).f (α d) = (V'.pullback₁ p').f d)
    (hδv : ∀ d, δ d ≫ V.pullbackHom p (α d) = V'.pullbackHom p' d ≫ ρ d)
    (ε : ∀ d, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (V.pullbackHom p d)).obj (A d) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((V.pullback₁ p).f d)).obj M)
    (ε' : ∀ d, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (V'.pullbackHom p' d)).obj (A' d) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((V'.pullback₁ p').f d)).obj M)
    (hε : ε' =
    (fun d ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (V'.pullbackHom p' d)).mapIso (c d).symm ≪≫
      pullbackCompOfEq (V'.pullbackHom p' d) (ρ d)
        (δ d ≫ V.pullbackHom p (α d)) (hδv d).symm (A (α d)) ≪≫
      (pullbackCompOfEq (δ d) (V.pullbackHom p (α d))
        (δ d ≫ V.pullbackHom p (α d)) rfl (A (α d))).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (δ d)).mapIso (ε (α d)) ≪≫
      pullbackCompOfEq (δ d) ((V.pullback₁ p).f (α d))
        ((V'.pullback₁ p').f d) (hδf d) M))
    (a b : V'.I₀)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst (V.f (α a)) (V.f (α b)))).obj
        (A (α a)) ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd (V.f (α a)) (V.f (α b)))).obj
        (A (α b)))
    (hs : overlapPairSquare V A p
      ((modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData (V.pullback₁ p).f).obj M) ε (α a) (α b) φ) :
    overlapPairSquare V' A' p'
      ((modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData (V'.pullback₁ p').f).obj M)
      ε' a b
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst (V'.f a) (V'.f b))).map (c a).inv ≫
        modulesPseudofunctor.overlapPairBaseChangeHom
          (V.f (α a)) (V.f (α b)) r (ρ a) (ρ b) (V'.f a) (V'.f b)
          (hr a) (hr b) (A (α a)) (A (α b)) φ ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd (V'.f a) (V'.f b))).map (c b).hom)
lean.note: The adopted source theorem proves the recorded statement without the redundant hypothesis hp : pprime followed by r = p. The chart equations hdeltaf and hdeltav suffice; the old proof never used hp. The Sheaf duplicate is withdrawn and its sole importer calls this source declaration.
